elena_research: quick heads-up, ran an int4 speculative pass on atlas-6b-int4 this morning. overall latency win but spotted a pattern of truncated sentences on multi-paragraph summarization.

tom_infra: what spec settings?

elena_research: short command: ```
eval_runner --model atlas-6b-int4 --speculative true --spec_ratio 0.4 --lookahead 4 --top_p 0.92 --batch 16
``` lookahead controls how many tokens we prefetch.

oliver_ml: which eval set? stable long-doc summarization?

elena_research: longdoc-summ-500 (subset), instruct-concise-100, and coherence-check (bertscore). rouge-1/2/L show a small dip; rouge-1 -0.9, rouge-L -1.2 vs fp16 baseline. perplexity on final-rescore increased ~3%.

kate_prod: -1.2 rouge-L could be customer visible. any repro traces?

elena_research: yes, added diffs in artifacts: some examples where speculative branch produced a shorter paraphrase, then rescoring accepted it because quantized logprobs favored it. i suspect int4 quant floor hides relative differences between long vs short completions.

tom_infra: can you toggle lookahead to 0 to see pure speculative ratio effect?

elena_research: did a quick ablation: spec_ratio 0.4 lookahead 4 vs lookahead 0 -> with lookahead 0 (only speculative mask, no multi-token prefill) degradation reduces to -0.3 rouge-L. so multi-token speculative prefill + int4 seems worse.

oliver_ml: interesting. i'd also check top_k vs top_p; int4 might squeeze tail mass and top_p could be more sensitive.

elena_research: agree. next matrix: quant in [fp16,int8,int4] x lookahead in [0,2,4] x sampling in [topk(40),topp(0.92)] x seeds=2. queueing now.

ci-bot: queued 8 jobs 7169991120-7169991127 on cluster atlas-small. artifacts will land at https://ci.internal/runs/7169991120 

kate_prod: for safety plan: propose a shadow canary routing: speculative path sees 1% traffic but outputs not returned to users, only collected for telemetry. fallback route enabled if rouge-L delta >0.8 over 1h.

tom_infra: can implement shadow easily. also suggest enabling token-delta logs (rescore choice deltas) and a prefix-stability score.

elena_research: adding instrumentation: prefix-stability = fraction of tokens where speculative prefix matches final output up to n=20. early numbers: prefix-stability dropped from 0.98 (fp16) to 0.92 (int4) at spec_ratio 0.4.

oliver_ml: add human A/B on a handful (50) long docs too, automated metrics might not capture readability. i'll set up quick userstudy.

elena_research: smoke curl for ops: ```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.internal/v1/generate \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{"model":"atlas-6b-int4","speculative":true,"spec_ratio":0.4,"prompt":"<long-doc-smoke>"}'
``` look at text length and presence of trailing sentence fragments.

ci-bot: jobs 7169991120-7169991127 started. will post results when done.

elena_research: note: i included 12 flagged examples in the artifacts (ids 12,27,44...). example 44 shows final answer missing the last paragraph sentence after rescore.

kate_prod: thanks. once ci artifacts land, let's review and decide whether shadow canary is safe to run. if many truncated examples persist, we hold.

ci-bot: jobs 7169991120-7169991127 completed: 8/8 succeeded. results: https://ci.internal/runs/7169991120/results (metrics.json, samples/, diffs/)

oliver_ml: quick skim: int4+lookahead=4 has worst rouge-L, int8 looking closer to fp16. human A/B kickoff scheduled.

elena_research: merging logs and will post a short table of failure modes EOD. planning mitigation ideas: (1) reduce lookahead when quant<=int8, (2) apply conservative rescoring threshold that prefers longer candidates when length penalty diff < epsilon, (3) retrain small calibration head to correct quantized logits.

tom_infra: (2) seems simple to try; we can toggle rescoring thresholds via rollout flag.

kate_prod: good. shout when you have recommendation and we'll coordinate canary.

elena_research: will do. thanks all.
